title: Nostalgic Snappy Greek Chicken Pilaf
description: A comforting, dairy-free-friendly Greek-style pilaf with snappy chicken and aromatic spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add the brown rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth, dried oregano, salt, and pepper to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the pilaf is cooking, whisk together the lemon juice and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
Once the pilaf is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the lemon-parsley mixture.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss with the pilaf.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
